messages.subject: .graph file creation from GIS files
parts:
Dear INLA team

Many thanks
Rachel

messages.author: 66ed4f72a898a51c
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] .graph file creation from GIS files
parts:
I usually use to read shapefiles with readOGR() from 'rgdal' package.
But, there is other packages that has functions to work with shapefiles.
Please see the Spatial R task view on
http://cran.r-project.org/web/views/Spatial.html

To produce neighborhood lists, I use the poly2nb() function from 'spdep'
package. To get the graph for the INLA Besag's model, I usually do
Matrix(nb2mat(nblist, style='B'))

messages.subject: Re: .graph file creation from GIS files
parts:
Thank you for your help.

I used

map=readOGR("map.shp","map")
nb.map <- poly2nb(map)
nb2INLA("map.graph",nb.map)

Best wishes
Rachel
